title: APEC summit: Trump to travel to China for talks with Putin, Xi
summary: US President Donald Trump is set to travel to the Chinese tech hub of Shenzhen for a much-anticipated meeting with Russian and Chinese counterparts. Follow live.
byline: Karl Sexton, Wesley Dockery, Mahima Kapoor

image.caption: Putin and Xi held talks ahead of their much anticipated summit with TrumpImage: Vyacheslav Prokofyev/Sputnik/Kremlin/AP/dpa/picture alliance

blocks.text: Xi calls for 'free and open trade' as counter to US tariffs

blocks.caption: Xi Jinping portrayed China as a stable and reliable global partner in his speechImage: Greg Baker/AFP

blocks.text: President Xi pledged to stand against trade protectionism in his speech at the APEC summit on Wednesday, in a subtle slight towards the United States and the trade war waged by its president.

Xi urged support for what he called "free and open trade," trying to ​portray his country as a stable partner on the global stage in contrast with its main economic rival, the US, which has raised tariffs ‌under President Trump.
His remarks came after Washington announced further restrictions on China's access to advanced AI chips from companies such as Nvidia, further complicating a trade truce between the two superpowers.
Xi urged that China and Russia, together, take concrete measures to further cooperation and "lead and advance the ⁠trend toward ​a multipolar world."
Chinese and Russian news agencies reported at around noon on Wednesday that Xi and Putin had met for talks. That's the fifth time the two leaders have met this year, including once by video link.
